recipe.name: ABUSE HUB - isolated model publication and keepalive
bootstrap: node -e "require.resolve('playwright'); console.log('Local test dependency available; no installation or production startup');"
build: node --check routing/keepalive-proxy.js && node --check routing/lib/api-gateway-dashboard.js && node --check routing/lib/api-gateway-integration.js && node --check routing/vendor/model-publication.js && node --check routing/vendor/api-gateway-tab.js && node --check routing/vendor/a6api-tab.js && node --check routing/vendor/gemini-tab.js && node --check tools/model-publication-preview.js && node --check tools/check-model-publication-http-ui.js

node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),vm=require('node:vm');const html=fs.readFileSync('routing/proxy-dashboard.html','utf8');let count=0;for(const match of html.matchAll(/<script\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/g)){if(match[1].trim()){new vm.Script(match[1]);count++;}}if(!count)throw new Error('No dashboard scripts found');console.log('Dashboard inline scripts compiled:',count);"
test: node --test --test-reporter=spec tools/check-api-gateway-publication.js tools/check-api-gateway-dashboard.js tools/check-api-gateway-integration.js tools/check-api-gateway-manifest.js tools/check-api-gateway-opencode.js tools/check-api-gateway-sync.js tools/check-keepalive-defaults.js tools/check-model-publication-surface.js
evidence: Scoped recipe: model publication, keepalive defaults, dashboard assets and affected Gateway transactions only.
Uses disposable homes, Claude/OpenCode targets and loopback fixture servers; no provider inference, live hub startup or dependency installation.
npm run check-hub and npm run check-deps are separate repository-wide gates; their unrelated failures are reported separately, not silently counted as passing here.
Set TMPDIR, TEMP and TMP to Hermes scratch before running so legacy tests also write only disposable artifacts there.
Readiness fixture expires after five seconds: native Windows shell teardown must not leave a child holding stdout open.
